Body.Content:
Updated November 23, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience. 

What and Why:

Copilot teaching tools help educators create and personalize resources right in OneNote Class Notebook. These include unit and lesson plans, rubrics, and Learning Activities such as flashcards, with options to suit different reading levels, languages, and learning needs.

Educators can build on content from the current page, then add generated materials and embed interactive activities alongside their existing notes.

Rollout Schedule:

Global: We will begin rolling out in mid-November 2026 and expect to complete by end of December 2026 (previously late November).

Impact on Your Organization:

Educators (who can already access teaching tools in the "Teach" tab of Copilot) will be able to use these same tools to prepare and share teaching resources without leaving Class Notebook.

Copilot teaching tools are available to eligible Microsoft 365 Education faculty and staff with Copilot enabled. No additional paid Copilot license is needed. Students can practice with Learning Activities shared by their educators; this does not give them access to educator teaching tools.

Action Required/Recommendations:

If your school already has Copilot and Learning Activities enabled for eligible users, no additional setup is needed. Review your access settings and let educators and support staff know about the new capabilities.

To manage or turn off access, follow the Education AI features admin guide. The two features have separate controls:

  • Copilot teaching tools are managed through Copilot access settings. Turning off access this way also restricts Copilot beyond teaching tools.
  • Learning Activities have separate controls. Turning off Copilot alone does not turn off Learning Activities. Encourage educators to review AI-generated materials for accuracy and suitability before sharing them with students.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
